findings.current: In the slums of Paris, teeming with mayflies and gangs.
findings.defect: “Mayflies” denotes a specific aquatic insect, whereas 날파리 here means the small flies or gnats infesting the slums.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the source's image of filthy, insect-ridden slums without introducing the wrong insect.
findings.replacement: In the slums of Paris, teeming with flies and gangs.

findings.current: All they had wanted was a friendly two-shot of two heroes—one old enough to be the other’s father—standing with their arms around each other’s shoulders, along with a few words of praise.
findings.defect: 덕담 means warm or well-wishing remarks, not necessarily praise directed at someone.
findings.rationale: The reporters expected a conventional cordial exchange, and “warm words” preserves that pragmatic register.
findings.replacement: All they had wanted was a friendly two-shot of two heroes—one old enough to be the other’s father—standing with their arms around each other’s shoulders, along with a few warm words.
findings.source: 그들이 원했던 것은 아버지와 아들뻘인 두 영웅이 어깨동무를 하고 찍은 다정한 투 샷과 덕담 몇 마디 정도였으니까.

findings.current: - Ah, No Jaehun, what the hell is that crazy bastard doing? The gang isn’t showing up, and he’s gone completely radio silent.
findings.defect: 갱 is the gaming term “gank,” not “gang,” and 잠수 타다 in this match context means going AFK rather than becoming unreachable by ordinary communication.
findings.rationale: The source describes No Jaehun failing to respond to a requested in-game gank and going AFK; the draft obscures both game actions.
findings.replacement: - Ah, what the fuck is that crazy bastard No Jaehun doing? I called for a gank, but he never came, and now he’s gone AFK as hell.
findings.source: 아, 노재헌 이 미친 새끼 뭐 하냐. 오라는 갱은 안 오고 잠수 오지게 타네.

findings.current: Dozens of television channels and internet streaming sites broadcasting live around the world caught fire,
findings.defect: “Caught fire” reads as literal combustion in English rather than the source's figurative sense that activity and attention suddenly surged.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the figurative escalation while avoiding an unintended claim that the broadcasters physically burned.
findings.replacement: Dozens of television channels and internet streaming sites broadcasting live around the world lit up with activity,
findings.source: 전 세계에서 생중계되는 수십 개의 TV 채널과 인터넷 스티리밍 사이트에 불이 붙었고

findings.current: The image of Jin Taekyung with a grim expression and Michael Silbert speaking one step ahead of him was reflected in countless eyes beyond the camera lenses.
findings.defect: “Speaking one step ahead” turns Michael's physical position into an apparent description of how he is speaking.
findings.rationale: 한 발자국 앞에서 specifies that Michael is physically one step in front of Jin while continuing his speech.
findings.replacement: The image of grim-faced Jin Taekyung and Michael Silbert, standing one step in front of him as he continued speaking, passed through the camera lenses and into countless eyes.
findings.source: 굳은 얼굴을 한 진태경과 그보다 한 발자국 앞에서 말을 이어가는 미카엘 실베르트의 모습이 카메라 렌즈를 넘어 무수히 많은 눈동자에 비치고 있었다.

findings.current:
After pouring out that speech, Michael Silbert swallowed.

No—the people watching him did the same.
findings.defect: The draft omits the object of 숨을 삼켰다 and consequently makes both Michael and the audience simply “swallow,” losing the shared breath-catching pause.
findings.rationale: 숨을 삼키다 here marks the tense intake or suspension of breath immediately before the announcement.
findings.replacement:
After pouring out that speech, Michael Silbert caught his breath.

No—everyone watching him did the same.
findings.source: 한바탕 말을 쏟아낸 미카엘 실베르트는 숨을 삼켰다. 아니, 그의 모습을 바라보던 모두가 마찬가지였다.

findings.current: The cameras shook violently, and the reporters’ sighs mixed into the microphones before being broadcast in their entirety.
findings.defect: 잘게 흔들리고 describes a fine or slight trembling, not violent shaking.
findings.rationale: The source depicts the camera operators' small involuntary tremors under shock; “violently” exaggerates the physical motion.
findings.replacement: The cameras trembled slightly, and the reporters’ sighs mixed into the microphones before being broadcast in their entirety.
findings.source: 카메라가 잘게 흔들리고 마이크에 섞여든 기자들의 탄식이 고스란히 전파를 타고 전해졌다.

findings.current: The eyes of those staring at Michael Silbert, who had foreseen the disaster either through a screen or with their own eyes, trembled.
findings.defect: The relative clause grammatically says Michael foresaw the disaster through either a screen or his own eyes. In the source, the audience is viewing Michael either on a screen or in person, while Michael is the one predicting the disaster.
findings.rationale: The replacement restores the correct subjects of both perception and prediction.
findings.replacement: The eyes of those staring at Michael Silbert—whether through a screen or with their own eyes—trembled at his prediction of disaster.
findings.source: 화면으로, 혹은 두 눈으로 재앙을 예견한 미카엘 실베르트를 응시하는 사람들의 눈빛이 파르르 떨렸다.

findings.current: At those words, a silent wave swept across the crowd.
findings.defect: 보이지 않은 means “unseen” or “invisible,” not “silent”; the draft changes the sensory quality of the metaphor.
findings.rationale: The source describes an invisible reaction propagating through the audience.
findings.replacement: At those words, an unseen wave swept across the crowd.
findings.source: 마침내 흘러나온 그 한 마디에, 보이지 않은 파동이 좌중을 휩쓸었다.

findings.current: Thirty years later, the remnants of the old heroes remained under the name International Hunter Federation.
findings.defect: The draft presents “thirty years later” as a bare narrative transition and drops both the present-time anchor 지금 and the approximation in 삼십여 년.
findings.rationale: The narration is describing the current institution after approximately thirty years have elapsed, not jumping the story forward by an exact thirty years.
findings.replacement: Now, roughly thirty years later, the remnants of those old heroes remained under the name International Hunter Federation.
findings.source: 삼십여 년이 흐른 지금, 국제 헌터 연맹이라는 이름으로 남아 있는 옛 영웅들의 잔재.

findings.current: The German Federal Army and police officers controlling them.
findings.defect: 독일 연방군 refers to Germany's federal armed forces as a whole, not specifically its army branch.
findings.rationale: “German Armed Forces” preserves the source's institutional scope without narrowing it to the army.
findings.replacement: The German Armed Forces and police officers controlling them.

findings.current: A cunning warlord wearing a hero’s mask was looking toward me with a smile.
findings.defect: “Warlord” adds a military role absent from 간웅, which characterizes Michael as a capable but treacherous and unscrupulous schemer.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves Jin's condemnation of Michael's deceitful ambition without inventing a title or role.
findings.replacement: An unscrupulous schemer wearing a hero’s mask was looking toward me with a smile.
findings.source: 영웅의 탈을 쓴 간웅(奸雄)이 이쪽을 바라보며 웃는다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but contains one gaming-mechanics mistranslation, several altered physical or perceptual details, and localized terminology and register issues.
